authority: #K2-361 sec.2.4: the judge takes the ECO-K2-0002/0003 sec.6 judging table as its SOLE SOURCE; #K2-360 sec.1 M4

source.note_no_file_named_checklist_check: the supervisor's text said 'reuse the existing checklist_check'; no in-register artifact carries that name (searched) - M4 therefore IMPLEMENTS the checklist and records this absorption instead of pretending to reuse a file that does not exist

C2_drc_no_new_increase.machine: total <= baseline AND no class present above the baseline class set

exclusion_basis.measured: running kicad-cli on a probe board OUTSIDE the project directory makes the footprint libraries unresolvable, so the SAME library warnings swap class: lib_footprint_mismatch 20 (reference, in-project) -> lib_footprint_issues 54 (probe, /tmp); every other class is identical (M3 residual attribution, #K2-361 sec.2.5)
exclusion_basis.why_excluded: these two classes report LIBRARY CONSISTENCY (a property of the DRC runner's library resolution), not copper geometry; they are RECORDED, never hidden
exclusion_basis.all_other_classes: must match the baseline exactly (no rise)

C4_chamfer_preserved.C4_threshold_unification: #K2-356 sec.2.2 says 'chamfer 166 preserved'; 166 is the OPERATION count applied by the L9 build (k2_p4_build_l9_v1 --stages chamfer), while 2637 is the measurable RESULT on l14 (45-degree segment count). ONE threshold, ONE machine form: 45-degree segment count >= 2637. The 166 figure is retained only as the provenance of that number and is NOT a second threshold.

C5_routing_changed.machine: segment-level element-set difference vs the reference != 0

C6_outside_copper_unchanged.machine: the multiset of track/via copper geometry OUTSIDE the swept region bbox(R u R+delta) is EXACTLY unchanged (canonical, 1um quantization)
C6_outside_copper_unchanged.scope: tracks+vias (routed copper); zone fill is governed by the refill step and by C2
C6_outside_copper_unchanged.note: clipping is exact for the board's 45/90 degree geometry; the comparison is quantized at 1um to absorb IU rounding

C7_hs_fanout_untouched.machine: the multiset of copper geometry of the named HS fanout nets (PCIE_DN0..DN7 _P/_N, 16 nets) is EXACTLY unchanged
C7_hs_fanout_untouched.nets: PCIE_DN0..7_P/N (J2 -> U6), listed in ECO-K2-0002 sec.6b

exam_extras.exam_B: plus C21 four-corner keepout all PASS (tools/k2_corner_keepout_gate_v1.py)

rule: PASS iff every criterion holds (C1-C7 for a block chain); a skipped criterion (missing tooling) is never a PASS
